news.title: Streetwise: Bond Traders Are Paying Too Much Attention to Oil Prices
news.summary: The relationship between oil and bond yields, and on to stock prices, is now well established.  Oil up, bond yields up, stocks down—with the day-to-day trading relationship between 10-year yields and oil futures this month reaching its tightest on record.  On Monday and Tuesday, bond yields fell a little as oil prices retreated; on Wednesday yields soared and oil rose; and on Thursday both rose again.
